title: Work and employment
theme: the job market, careers and working conditions
goal: Recognise and use 24 words and collocations for discussing jobs, careers and working conditions in TEF and TCF tasks.

example.fr: Mon employeur paie une partie de mes cours de français.
example.en: My employer pays part of my French classes.

example.fr: L'entreprise compte une cinquantaine d'employés.
example.en: The company has about fifty employees.

example.fr: Le chômage a baissé dans la région cette année.
example.en: Unemployment went down in the region this year.

example.fr: Karim est au chômage depuis trois mois.
example.en: Karim has been unemployed for three months.

example.fr: Le taux de chômage est plus élevé chez les jeunes.
example.en: The unemployment rate is higher among young people.

example.fr: Il est difficile d'entrer sur le marché du travail sans expérience canadienne.
example.en: It is hard to enter the job market without Canadian experience.

example.fr: Lisez bien votre contrat de travail avant de le signer.
example.en: Read your employment contract carefully before signing it.

example.fr: Sofia veut faire carrière dans la santé.
example.en: Sofia wants to build a career in health care.

example.fr: Cette promotion s'accompagne de nouvelles responsabilités.
example.en: This promotion comes with new responsibilities.

example.fr: Nguyen a obtenu une promotion après deux ans.
example.en: Nguyen got promoted after two years.

example.fr: Le syndicat négocie de meilleurs salaires.
example.en: The union is negotiating better wages.

example.fr: L'usine a licencié deux cents personnes.
example.en: The factory dismissed two hundred people.

example.fr: Les infirmières dénoncent leurs conditions de travail.
example.en: Nurses are speaking out against their working conditions.

example.fr: Ma charge de travail a doublé depuis janvier.
example.en: My workload has doubled since January.

example.en: Many newcomers go through a career change.

example.fr: Les contrats courts augmentent la précarité.

steps.title: Words for the world of work

blocks.title: Usage tips
blocks.body: [[Le chômage]] is the situation; say [[être au chômage]], not *être en chômage*. Watch out: [[une carrière]] can also mean a quarry, and [[une promotion]] can also be a special offer in a shop. In Québec, [[la conciliation travail-famille]] and [[travailleur autonome]] are standard; in France you hear [[l'équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée]] and [[travailleur indépendant]].

blocks.title: Listen and repeat
blocks.note: Say each sentence out loud. These are ready-made sentences for the speaking test.

blocks.prompt: Amira lost her job last month. Which sentence is correct?
blocks.explain: The fixed expression is être au chômage.
optionFeedback: The preposition is au, not en.

blocks.prompt: Which word completes: « Après dix ans comme comptable, Raj a fait une ___ : il est devenu enseignant. »
blocks.explain: Changing to a completely different job is une reconversion professionnelle.
optionFeedback: A promotion is a better job in the same career.
That is the amount of work you have.

blocks.prompt: The unemployment rate is going down.
accept: Le taux de chômage est en baisse.
blocks.explain: le taux de chômage is masculine; baisser or diminuer both mean “to go down”.

blocks.prompt: She earns a living as a nurse.
accept: Elle gagne sa vie comme infirmière.
Elle gagne sa vie en tant qu'infirmière.
blocks.explain: Gagner sa vie comme + job, with no article before the job.

blocks.en: Remote work makes it easier to balance work and family.
blocks.explain: In Québec, the set phrase is la conciliation travail-famille.

blocks.text: Trop d'heures supplémentaires peuvent mener à l'___ professionnel.
blocks.en: Too much overtime can lead to burnout.
blocks.explain: L'épuisement professionnel is the French term for burnout.

blocks.fr: Lisez bien votre contrat de travail avant de le signer.
blocks.explain: contrat ends in a silent t; de travail has no article.

blocks.fr: Mei est travailleuse autonome : elle choisit ses clients.
blocks.en: Mei is self-employed: she chooses her clients.
blocks.explain: [[Travailleuse autonome]] is the Québec term for a self-employed woman.

summary:
- Talk about the job market: [[le chômage, le taux de chômage, le marché du travail]]
- Describe pay and conditions: [[le revenu, la charge de travail, la conciliation travail-famille]]
- Discuss careers: [[obtenir une promotion, se reconvertir, gagner sa vie]]
